scenarios.name: Add and switch between browser panel tabs

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/blank-drawing.odd` is active in the MCAD Software
its Model browser is docked on the left
an additional log panel is available in the browser's plus menu
the user adds the log panel from the plus menu
the log panel becomes active in the same dock
the Model browser remains available as a tab
the user selects the Model browser tab
the drawing resources and sheet tree are displayed
the user selects the log panel tab
the log area is displayed in the dock
the user closes the log panel tab
